Which shortwave stations broadcast aimed at Africa?

In the A-26 schedule, 49 stations broadcast aimed at Africa. The most heavily scheduled include BBC, China Radio International, Radio France International, Radio Vaticana.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts aimed at Africa?

The most-used frequencies are 15565, 17640, 15300, 13830, 15390 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
